main.description: A voice-practice recording: reading from a book, a fixed passage, free speech, or a pitch or resonance exercise.

createdAt.description: When the practice happened. Practice days are derived from this.

activity.description: What kind of practice this was. Absent means reading (records from before activities existed).

work.description: Title of what was practiced: the book being read, the passage, the free-speech topic, or the exercise.

passage.description: For a passage: which one, so recordings of the same text can be compared.

chapter.description: Chapter or passage identifier within the work.

durationMs.description: Length of the audio in milliseconds, if known.

notes.description: Freeform notes about the practice session.

transcript.description: What was read, as text: transcribed by a speech-to-text service the reader chose, and possibly edited by them.

id.description: A built-in passage ("builtin:<name>") or, later, the AT URI of the reader's own passage record.

model.description: The speech-to-text model that produced it, if known (e.g. whisper-1).

edited.description: Whether the reader changed the text after it was transcribed.

words.description: When each word was spoken, as transcribed (before any edits to text).
